elaine: Quick a11y pass on the model-detail panel — noticed a few things: focus ring jumps when right rail toggles, tag contrast on env pills is low, and keyboard nav gets stuck inside the session modal. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/markup123.png samir: Thanks — can you paste quick repro steps? I want to repro locally. elaine: Repro steps: 1) Open model detail > click 'Versions' to open right rail. 2) Tab to first tag pill, press right-arrow to move focus (should move between pills), sometimes focus goes to background. 3) Open session modal, press tab repeatedly, focus doesn't reach close button. Happens on Chrome macOS. maria: Sounds like a roving tabindex vs native tab mismatch. We added roving to chips earlier but didn't mirror it for the modal list. Suggest switching session list to role="listbox" + aria-activedescendant and roving tabindex. jon: Agree re: pills — color token `--status-accent` on light mode is borderline. Quick contrast check: text #6b7280 on white gives ~3.2:1. We need 4.5:1 for small text. elaine: For the focus ring we use `outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--focus-rgb), .15)` — offset seems to get clipped when the rail animates. Parent has `overflow: hidden` which may be clipping the shadow. a11y-bot: Automated scan: 12 issues found. Highlights: missing aria-label on 'Compare' button in versions list, non-semantic role on pills (role='button' without keyboard handlers), and low contrast on `.env-pill.small`. See full report: https://a11y.redwood/reports/1765439999 samir: I'll own the modal roving fix. Plan: update session list to use roving tabindex + arrow handling, add a skip link to `#session-close` as fallback, and ensure ESC closes modal and returns focus. Will open PR. maria: I'll take pills: update color token for `.env-pill.small` to `--text-muted` in light theme, and add a visible focus indicator that doesn't depend on outline clipping. Also add `aria-pressed` if they act as toggles. elaine: :thumbsup: Small copy nit: change header 'Close session' -> 'End session' for clarity in the modal. jon: Also add an ops checklist item to run contrast tests on rollout. :white_check_mark: samira-ux: I can run a keyboard-only walkthrough tomorrow at 2pm. I'll test VoiceOver + NVDA and report any voice/announce differences. samir: I'll include test steps in the PR description. If folks have specific cases, drop them here. maria: Quick test cases to include: 1) Tab to pills, arrow keys move focus, space/enter toggles. 2) Open modal, tab to close button, ESC closes, focus returns to trigger. 3) SR: when modal opens announce `Sessions list, 3 items` and announce selection changes. elaine: Also add an aria-live region for success/error messages in the modal (role='status') so screen readers get updates. jon: Minor dev note: avoid relying on `outline-offset` for major visibility; use an inner focus ring element or `box-shadow` with no clipping. samir: Will send a canary PR this afternoon with the fixes and a small code snippet for the roving behavior: ```html
  • Session A
  • Session B
``` maria: Nice. I'll include updated color tokens and add visual test screenshots in the PR. a11y-bot: Follow-up scan scheduled after PR merge. elaine: Thanks everyone — will add the UX copy change to the content backlog and review the PR when ready.
